Initial release of work-productivity-skillscan-security-workflow-helper.

- Provides proven SkillScan-style workflows for security, productivity, and bug fixing tasks on Clawhub.
- Supports users needing help with workflow design, checklist creation, reliability improvements, and setup hardening.
- Produces actionable, local-hardware-friendly outputs: templates, scripts, checklists to minimize manual coordination.
- Includes clear validation steps and verification notes to align artifacts with user needs and success criteria.
